oracle.oracle_text: Each player sacrifices five lands of their choice. Destructive Force deals 5 damage to each creature.

reason: Root directed whole-source deferral after a cross-runtime failure-kind audit. The compiled Destructive Force cleanup starts by reading sacced[count] before decrementing count: every nonzero count reads beyond initialized selections, and count five reads beyond the five-element array. This undefined behavior makes all productive source paths unsuitable for an active baseline, including fourteen assertion-only paths that happened to remain stable. Its later boolean marked[p][slot] value is also incorrectly passed as the slot to kill_card. Final2 native bare_zones cases had thirteen assertions each; Wasm original and isolated both crashed with DUEL_ENGINE_ERROR bad parameters get_card_instance(0,1769235317), through state_untargettable and card_destructive_force. All twenty-four original variants, full Oracle expectations, decoded bodies and all available runtime logs are retained here; no gameplay fix or weakened assertion was applied.
root_decision: Remove the complete new active home; preserve all variants, not only the two observed Wasm crashes

evidence_storage.hash_definition: Artifact keys are SHA256 of decompressed UTF-8 bytes. original_file_sha256 hashes actual full external file bytes when available. original_text_sha256 hashes the prior archived full text after universal-newline decoding.
evidence_storage.scope: Logs retain the exact RUN through own result line, or complete crash tail. XML retains the exact raw matching testcase element. Non-case wrappers/other tests are omitted; full original files remain at the pinned evidence paths.
evidence_storage.offset_definition: start_char/end_char are Python Unicode character offsets into prior full UTF-8 text read with universal newlines (LF), not offsets into raw CRLF file bytes.
